outcome: Perinatal asphyxia severity (indicated by Apgar score)
Duration of respiratory support (including mechanical ventilation)
cohort: The study included 129 neonates born at >=37 weeks' gestation with an Apgar score <=7.
finding: Elevated serum and urinary UA/Cr ratios were significantly associated with lower Apgar scores, indicating their potential as early indicators of the severity of perinatal asphyxia.
